title: Excellent private tour with fantastic guide!
text: We did a private walking tour of Sevilla and our guide, Paula, was fantastic! She is a native of Sevilla with a PhD in art history and she had a wonderful way of explaining things in an interesting way. She was friendly, kind and even gave us recommendations  for food and things to do after the tour. We were quite late to the tour because we misjudged how much we would sleep after our 24 hour travel day and Paula could not have been nicer about waiting for us when she could have been (rightfully) impatient. Excellent choice for people wanting a more boutique and personalized experience with an
author: catheriney424

title: Wonderful 2-Hour Family Tour in Seville
text:
Mila was fantastic. We had some travel issues, and she was very accommodating—moving our tour two hours later to fit our schedule. She took us to several key spots and shared many interesting facts along the way.

She also went above and beyond by asking about our daughter beforehand and arriving with an “I Spy” worksheet and colored pencils to keep her entertained.

We highly recommend Mila and Yannat, and we’ll certainly be in touch the next time we’re in the area.
author: alarkin423

title: Fantastic walking tour in Seville
text: Exceptional walking tour with Manuel. He was warm, welcoming and keen to accommodate our interests. He guided us expertly around the centre of Seville, with deep knowledge of history, architecture, culture and food. We loved the stories and background to this lovely city and he gave us advice and recommendations for food places and flamenco. Highly recommended.
author: Elliot_D

title: Best tour in Europe!
text: The best tour we've ever taken in Europe. Cristina was an amazing guide--friendly and deeply knowledgeable. You will see impressive sights and get the inside scoop on Seville's rich history and architecture. An absolute must for any visitor!
author: L6708CDryanm

title: Fabulous Seville Walking Tour
text: This private walking tour was fabulous! Our guide, Maria, is from Seville. She was amazing!  We took this tour on Palm Sunday & she navigated the busy city with ease. She shared a wealth of knowledge from start to finish. She was very informative, courteous & professional. We were a group of 10 family members- ranging in age from 27 yrs old to 72 yrs old & everyone enjoyed this tour. I highly recommend this tour & guide without hesitation. Maria- Thank you for sharing your city with my family!  Diane - Texas.
author: dianegJ5998ZB

title: Best tour of the city!
text: It was a great experience.  Julio had a depth of knowledge of history, both Seville and Spain in general.  He had wonderful stories which brought the history to life and made it real.  It was an on and off rainy day, but we still had a great tour with Julio.  Our highest recommendations for him.
author: Peter_W

title: Great time in Santa Cruz
text: We had an excellent tour led by Yohanna. She was very flexible about what we wanted to see and just made the time fit perfectly. Great time seeing Sanat Cruz area before the stunning Plaza de Espana
author: Dominic_M

title: Sevilla Tour
text: The best way to make an approach to a city like Seville, full of history and tradition. Our guide was Julio, a local guy in love with Seville. He recommended us local bars, some wine and for a couple of hours we walked around the historical center. A great success.
author: G9619FImanuele

title: One of the best experience we had travelling.
text: Seville's 2-hour tour was a lovey escape for my husband and me. Plaza de España's mind-blowing architecture and Barrio de Santa Cruz's alleys bursting with vibrant hues had us totally captivated. The guide's knowledge added a layer of richness to the experience, making it an unforgettable journey through Seville's magic. Highly recommended for a short trip in this splendid city.
author: soniaaO3492FH

title: Fun and educational
text: Excellent private walking tour fun and educational Candela was very kind and thoughtful she knew so much interesting local history.
